name: Build worker source substitution
description: Worked example of an effective compile-stage mutant on the git target. Models replacing or modifying a project's source file on the build worker immediately before compilation, causing the build to incorporate attacker-controlled code that drops a marker file upon execution while the repository's committed source remains unchanged. This operator carries an effect block so the validator can classify the mutant as 'effective' (not merely build_valid).

placeholders.SOURCE_FILE: path to the source file selected for modification

preconditions: project compiles source files on a build worker
the attacker can modify source files in the build environment before compilation
the modified source file is consumed by the compiler
